notes.title: Blimps 2.3.8
notes.notes: [p]Blimps 2.3.8[/p][p]We’re excited to introduce some fantastic new features:[/p][list][*][p]Chum Buckets: Get ready for fishing with chum buckets full of harpoon bait.[/p][/*][*][p]Catch of the Day: Sell your catches at the trading Stork ports.[/p][/*][*][p]Captain Biographies: Discover the stories behind each captain and choose new starting buffs. [/p][/*][*][p]Pigeon Post Tubes: Players now receive 1 to 6 tube mail pieces daily.[/p][/*][*][p]Crosshairs Navigation: Control the crosshairs easily with the left joystick and L1/R1 shoulder buttons on gamepads.[/p][/*][/list][p]Explore these upgrades and start your open-world survival adventure today! We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: Blimps on the Steam Deck!
notes.notes: [p]We purchased a [b]Steam Deck[/b] specifically to playtest [b]Blimps[/b], and we are excited to announce that the game runs and plays exceptionally well on the device! Initially designed for mobile tablets and desktop computers, we later added gamepad support, allowing for a seamless gaming experience.[/p][p]The [b]Steam Deck[/b] brilliantly demonstrates the versatility of control options available for [b]Blimps[/b], giving players the freedom to navigate the game in multiple engaging ways. We invite you to immerse yourself in [b]Blimps[/b] and experience it for yourself. And as always, Thanks for playing![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Blimps 2.3.7
notes.notes: [p]Introducing the Dogcatcher, a new platformer boss battle where players can collect gold bars, which can then be used at "Blimp My Ride," a newly added world port, to upgrade the capacity of their Blimps. We also added an end-of-day popup that rewards players for surviving another day. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: Ed, creator/developer of BLIMPS, playing BLIMPS!
notes.notes: Ed playing Blimps.  Please join the chat to ask any questions you may have about Blimps. Also, please reach out to me with any bugs you may come across playing BLIMPS, and I'll do my best to address them ASAP in the next version update. I'm also always open to any ideas on how to better improve Blimps. Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy the game! -Ed creator/developer of BLIMPS

notes.title: Blimps 1.9.9
notes.notes: Introducing Toe Goes Subs. A new side-scrolling mini-game inside Blimps. Rent a submarine and trawl the ocean floor for enough Helium-3 to make a "no power loss" fusion battery for your Blimp. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.9.8
notes.notes: We fixed some more reported bugs. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.9.7
notes.notes: We updated the select your captain and blimp coin room and added a time and power clock to your hanger's office. We also fixed some minor bugs. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.9.6
notes.notes: We fixed some bugs in the Local Stork Market. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.9.5
notes.notes: We added Doug's Diggers drilling ports. Players can now navigate a mini earth drill through a vast underground labyrinth and use their element bombs to help collect the loot found in the new earth maze. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: BLIMPS 1.9.4
notes.notes: We added Airheart's Hot Air Balloon Launch ports. Players can now navigate a hot air balloon through a vast mountain labyrinth and use their element bombs to help collect the loot found in the new cloud maze. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: BLIMPS 1.9.2
notes.notes: We added the Mechanicsburdh windmill port, where players can now buy and equip Element Shields, Bombs, and EMP's onto their Blimps. In addition, the Pirate Battle room has been updated to a more involved battling experience. The HUD now includes your Blimp's Arsenal pop-up menu, and players can tell if their CAPS lock is on for the cheat codes to work on their console prompts. The HELP computer and Local Stork Market have been updated as well. And last but not least, we added the Selection of the King mini-game to the world of Blimps on Wrensdays. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.9.1
notes.notes: Introducing the Blimps calendar! The new calendar adds some features to the game. The game now has sped-up time: 1 hour passes every 30 seconds. However, completed game scores are still calculated against the real-time it takes to finish the game. Players now have 5 game-time days to find the Moon Crystal for 1st place(which still equals 1 hour in real-time). Please note that some aspects of the game now depend on the calendar day. For example, Pigeon Post Tube mail only comes on Frydays, and you can only get game tips on Falconsday. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.9.0
notes.notes: Introducing the Overstork item of the day! The currently trading 'S'tork port now features a unique item for sale. In addition, we added new weather and pirate blimp spawning rate options in the settings menu. Also, we gave the new game intro a bit of a facelift. Finally, we added a ticker-tape typewriter to the Hawk Mainframe Terminal and the Hanger's hallway to help with where to go and what to do. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.9
notes.notes: We added the option to turn off the random weather events in the settings menu. We reduced the power loss that weather event decisions take from your Blimp. Finally, we added the Vulture Weather Scope(VWS) as a purchasable equipment upgrade in the "S"tork port markets. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.8
notes.notes: Introducing "Builder" and "Bounty" game modes. We added these two new modes to simplify and clarify the pirate blimp world spawning rates. They can be chosen via the "settings" button on the printer in the stats room. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.7
notes.notes: Introducing "in-case-of-emergency industries, inc." a new air tow service that alleviates the pain of flying slowly back to your hanger to recharge if you run out of power. Also, we reduced the cost of wiping out pirate blimps via the E.M.P. by half. The pirate spawn rate has also been reduced: Less than 20 hanger departures and 10x pirate blimps spawn each launch. Greater than 20 departures and the spawn rate equals your departures. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.6
notes.notes: We fixed several bugs that were reported to us. The cargo insurance reimbursement was not functioning correctly in the Goose Insurance Claims room. Also, you can now load 8x NaCl back onto your Blimp from the Woodpecker Warehouse. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.5
notes.notes: We fixed some minor bugs we came across during our last play-through. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.4
notes.notes: We added some fun sound FX to the buttons, machines, and robots you come across. In addition, we added three new "Choose Your Own Adventure" style story events into the world. Minor bugs fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.3
notes.notes: You can now eliminate, clone, or freeze hostile blimps with your element cannons. Renovated Level 1 and 2 Doors. Minor bug fixes, gameplay improvements, and some more Easter eggs. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.2
notes.notes: We added gamepad controller support when flying your Blimp and using your element canons around the world. In addition, you can now adopt a cat, dog, or some plants for your hanger. Minor bug fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.1
notes.notes: Cloud City is now fully operational. We also added E.M.P.TY The Skies Incorporated and renovated the Eggschange and Race Rooms. Front-end adjustments, minor bug fixes, and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.8.0
notes.notes: We updated the HUD with a Map and Blimp Safe. Minor bug fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.7.9
notes.notes: We added the option to submit your completed game score to an online Blimps scoreboard whenever you finish the game. Your completed game score is calculated using this formula: Game Time(Hours*60+Minutes) - Game Tasks. The lower your score, the better. We also renovated the Eagle Eye Customs and Immigration Busted Room. Minor bug fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.7.8
notes.notes: We updated the world map and the location of Blackbirds, Ed's Tow Charge, and the Oasis. Balance updates, bug fixes, and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.7.7
notes.notes: We added the autosave feature. Your game now automatically saves whenever you fly home to your hanger. New games start with the autosave on, but you can turn it off on the printer if you prefer to manually save your game. We also added Ed's Tow Charge. Minor bug fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.7.5

notes.title: Blimps 1.7.4

notes.title: Blimps 1.7.2
notes.notes: We added collector's stamps to the Pigeon Post Tubes and the Daffodil Medal of Honor achievement stamp to the passport. In addition, we renovated the end game cut-scenes. As always, minor bug fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.8
notes.notes: Lots of tweaks are included in version 1.6.8.  Pop-up inventory menus have been added to your dashboard to help you keep track of items you have purchased, made, or found. Redesigned Phoenix Financial, your savings balance now earns interest when it reaches specific amounts. Updated the HELP computer's General tab. Increased the game completion tasks to 77.  Various art enhancements and bug fixes. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.6
notes.notes: Graphic performance improvements.

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.5
notes.notes: Performance and stability fixes.

notes.notes: Added the "Race to the Moon Crystal" compete against Space Y, Nile X, and Sir Space to be the first to find the moon crystal! Randomized the starting cash money. Minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.3

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.2

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.0
notes.notes: Added a cut scene to the VIP lounge entrance and locked up the hanger's office with four keys. Minor bug fixes and enhancements.

notes.title: Blimps 1.5.9
notes.notes: Introducing the Office, Towns and Pigeon Post Tubes update. You can now build towns to receive rental income via the new Pigeon Post Tubes, a new pneumatic mail tube system installed in your hanger. Game progress and task completion stats have also been added to the printout summary stats. The Hawk computer interface has been updated and the hanger has been rearranged a bit. There is now an office and a break room in the hanger. Minor bug fixes and art enhancements.

notes.title: Blimps 1.5.3
notes.notes: Introducing the Eggschange, a place to barter for items, and the Preening Peacock, a place to buy new clothes for your captain. Various other bug fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.5.1
notes.notes: A new blimp company save slot system has been installed. *Please note you may lose any previously saved games with this update. :( We hope you enjoy the game, thanks for playing! :)

notes.title: Blimps 1.5.0

notes.title: Blimps 1.3.5
notes.notes: Added a Help menu and a World Map Room located at Falcon Flight Control. Also added three game modes, easy, normal, and hard.
